name: Shamrock no Hanakotoba
original_name: シャムロックの花言葉
source:
Kouko heard an unbelievable rumour that her friend Nanaka was doing compensated dating and questioned her about it, but Nanaka brushed her off and run away. Worried about her friend, she started to search for her and ended up participating in the same activity as well. She hated it at first, but it was difficult to obtain information about this shady community unless she had first-hand experience. What she found inside was that Nanaka had become obsessed with the man who had also defiled her, and she decided to sell her own body to save her friend. It would be a negative cycle that would also entangle friends Matsuri and Aki…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/05/02/may-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
